title: Coordinated kernel84: fresh two-platform witness and exact packing ceiling
body:
This adds a self-contained conditional kernel84 certificate at **κ = 0.001389125582984265**, plus an exact packing ceiling showing that every whole-helper schedule retaining this local word has **κ < 0.001389210509385421**. Less than 0.0062% remains through scheduling alone under those stated restrictions.

The construction applies #508's coordinated gauge collapse to #507's partial-own factory and retains all 84 pivots. It reallocates all 40,320 helpers against #508's offset-six call order, then independently checks the literal owner maps, Gaussian phases, normalized spectators, complete controller and finite invoice. The complex endpoint is **b = 0.001391057937152176875572**; #493's freshly rebuilt bit supplier is nonbinding. No headline gains are added together.

**Frontier comparison:** #514 subsequently reported κ = 0.001391523459591829 using a different 92-pivot word. This PR does not claim to exceed it. That changed word lies outside the packing ceiling's explicit assumptions. The 92-pivot source reconstruction reproduced its published semantic hash locally; no full #514 replay is claimed here.

The packing bound drops every timing, owner-collision and chart restriction. Its 112 complete integer patterns yield a rational dual checked by both independent moment engines. The checker imports no optimizer and rejects five corrupted certificates. The LP is used only to nominate the dual. This provides a concrete reason to change the local construction instead of extending scheduling searches on this word.

**Both cold Python3.14 runs passed on macOS arm64 and Linux aarch64.** All seven outer stages,21 dependency stages and13 coordinated-local stages passed on each platform. The complete stable result files are byte-identical: `b5700b468a40f9e142165999b4818a6de0af53183f801b8057c0a40fa78c9c59`. Receipts, genuine Boost/compiler checks, guarded physics and exact assembly evidence are attached. GitHub CI is separate and is not claimed passed. The verifier rebuilds both suppliers, the partial-own factory, the coordinated word and all global stages without accepting cached outputs. The source package is immutable; all 328 copied source files were checked against exact Git bytes. The inherited PR507 portability repair pins only two historical floating display annotations, preserving its mathematical and frozen-word hash assertions.

Inherited all-size compiler, mutable-basis/common-label transport, Lemma A realization, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer conditions remain. This is a finite conditional witness and a scoped packing bound, not an unconditional multiplication theorem or κ=1 result.

Credits: eumemic #507/#493; Dugongue #508/#505; Rohan Arun #473's scheduling and flow-capacity work; DreamingOfClouds #484; #496, #495, #501/#502, #458 and the retained earlier authors. New composition, literal allocation, two-platform wrapper and exact packing dual by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance. Licenses, original sources and notices are retained.
